blocks.text: Demonstration document. Not for filing or payment.
Business address: 2150 Harbor Ridge Ave S, Suite 300, Seattle, WA 98134
Information returns for 2026: 101 Forms W-2, and the Forms 1099 prepared from these files
Filing method: Electronic, through the IRS Information Returns Intake System (IRIS)
Accounts payable: Every vendor payment is made by check or ACH from accounts payable, or charged to the corporate card ending 4417 and posted through accounts payable
Corporate card: Card charges are settled by the card issuer; the payer does not report them
Backup withholding: 24% withheld from reportable payments to a payee with no TIN on file; credited to account 2215 and deposited for Form 945
State: Washington; no state income tax and no state copy of Form 1099 is filed
Prepared by the controller from the accounts payable system on January 12, 2027. Not signed.
